caption: The drawing depicts a single, vertically oriented, elongated metal object with a slightly twisted shaft. At the top of the object, there is a circular loop. Along the length of the shaft, there are three sets of barbed hooks extending outward in opposite directions, with each set comprising two curved hooks facing away from each other. The bottom end features an additional set of hooks, with three larger barbed hooks arranged in a trident-like formation. The object is rendered in shades of gray and black, giving it a metallic appearance. The background is a plain, light beige color, with subtle variations in shading. There is no other object or decoration in the composition.
title: Meat Hook
